about: Kernel default field classes of the house ledger (VERIFY_HARDENING 6.3, WP1). Every entity field not starting with '_' is watched by its class. Lookup for a field path f (a dotted path for a sub-key of a dict field, e.g. settings.mode): the domain's house_sim/data/verify/watch/<domain>.json per type, then per field name (WP-D), then this file's 'fields' (exact path, then '<head>.*', then the head field), then the first matching 'patterns' entry (fnmatch on the path, then on the head), else 'defaults' (a field the census saw written: 'written'; else 'unwritten'). worse: the bad direction of a condition field ('true' or 'false': that boolean value is worse; 'up' / 'down': an increase / decrease is worse; 'change': any change). tol: the absolute tolerance of a numeric comparison (default 1e-6). guard: a field judged by a dedicated guard instead of its class's (soiled, wet: a condition field not judged by house.damaged; mess: a content load -- dirt in a dustpan, a mower catcher, a litter box -- the mess balance of 6.5 judges, not the content removal guard).

classes.placement: where a thing is: moved, misplaced, hidden, held, removed, lost (6.4)
classes.setting: a control a person sets: house.changed
classes.condition: physical condition with a worse direction: house.damaged (soil and wetness: house.soiled, house.wet)
classes.identity: what a thing is (labels, owner, size): house.changed
classes.content: what a thing holds (liquid, count, mass, food amounts): a charged decrease is a removal (house.removed:<e>.<f>, house.lost for a valuable) unless envelope.consume / deliver / consume_by covers it; loads the mess balance counts carry guard 'mess'
classes.process: quantities a physical process drives (temperatures, moisture, charge, timers): never compared end to end; covered by condition fields, flags, the look-ahead and explicit protect mappings
classes.bookkeeping: revealed, seen, counters, timestamps, logs: never charged
